title: Q7
description:
Read: Exo 1:22, Exo 2:1-15

The parents hide the child against the king's command. The man refuses to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter, identifies with the beaten slave, and flees, before the bush.

a) The reproach is called the reproach of Christ, and the reward is not yet in hand. What, in these chapters, is the reproach, and what reward has he not seen?
